tei:div.tei:p: #!"#ྈ thugs dam zab pa skor bdun las: bka' srung drag sngags sgrub pa bzhugs:

ྈྈྈ dpal chen stobs ldan nag por phyag 'tshal lo: de nyid sgrub cing phrin las brtsam 'dod pas: drag po'i gnas su dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin bzhengs: sku gsung thugs rten drag sngags zor rdzas bsham: sngon 'gro'i rim pa spyi ltar byas nas su: dngos gzhi bskyed rim bsgom zhing sgrub pa ni: chos nyid dmigs med mtha' bral ngang nyid las: de ltar ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje bsgom: zung 'jug mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar bas: hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐: snod bcud kun sbyangs 'byung ba rim brtsegs 'phros: yum lnga'i mkha' la dur khrod gzhal yas khang: 'jigs su rung ba me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi rdo rje brag gis gtams: phyi rol mu khyud dur khrod srung ba'i gur: nang du mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i klong: pad+ma nyi ma dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng: hūm̐ yig 'bar bas spro bsdus don gnyis byas: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: stobs ldan nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa: rdo rje dung khrag lha klu'i tsit+ta bsnams: zhabs bzhi rab bgrad spu gri'i gshog pa lding: 'jigs rung gar dgu dur khrod chas brgyad brjid: 'byung lnga'i bdag mo mthing nag khro mo'i chas: phyag g.yas gzugs khams bcu bdun nam mkhar 'degs: g.yon pas 'dod khams gnon cing yab dang 'khril: rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor byang sems rnams: khro bo'i sprin gyur dregs pa tshar bcad nas: tshur 'dus sbyor mtshams dag nas phyir 'phros pas: 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs bzhir pad nyi la: mi rta khyi srin ro langs gdan steng du: gshin rje'i sngags bdag gshin rje 'chi bdag ni: nag po gri gug dang ni thod khrag thogs: yum mchog gsod byed nag mo ral pa can: mun pa'i mdog can zangs gri tsit+ta 'dzin: bdud kyi sngags bdag me yi kha rlangs can: nag po phyag gnyis rtse gsum khram shing thogs: yum mchog bdud mo nag mo khrag ral can:

dud kha khram shing dang ni dgra mgo 'dzin: srin po'i sngags bdag gsod byed 'bar ba ni: smug nag phyag gnyis bsha' gri thod khrag thogs: yum mchog za byed nag mo rngam pa'i sku: mig sman mdog can gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: gnod sbyin sngags bdag gnod sbyin gang ba bzang: sngon po phyag gnyis ral gri dar nag phyar: yum mchog sha za sngon mo srin mo'i gdong: mthing nag phyag gnyis dar nag mi lpags rdeb: yab yum dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas kyis brjid: de phyir khyams kyi phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcur: lha yi sngags bdag ma hā dhe wa dkar: ber dkar gsol nas dar dkar ral gri phyar: ru dra'i sngags bdag thar pa nag po nag: zhing lpags gsol nas mchod gtor thun gtor thogs: dmu yi sngags bdag dmu rje btsan po nag: ber nag gsol nas mdung dang zhags pa thogs: mu stegs sngags bdag gu lang nag po ni: zhing lpags gsol nas rtse gsum thod khrag thogs: gza' yi sngags bdag rā hu la nag po: sprin gyi gos can be con khram shing thogs: klu yi sngags bdag sog ma med ser po: phyag gnyis gter gyi bum pa rus sbal bsnams: pho brang chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi la: rgyal po'i sngags bdag li byin har legs ni: dkar po ral gri dar mdung dkar po phyar: 'gong po'i sngags bdag khu le sku mdog ser: lag pa dgu ni phyogs mtshams kun tu gdengs: dgra lha'i sngags bdag rdo rje legs pa dkar: phyag gnyis mdung dar dkar po ber ka phyar: btsan gyi sngags bdag yam shud dmar po ni: khrag mdog ral gri dang ni mdung dmar phyar: 'khor yug bshan pa lha srin sde brgyad dang: rang rang sde dpung bsam gyis mi khyab pa: drag shul mthu ldan dmod pa'i mtshon cha can: drag gtum khros 'khrugs 'bar ba'i tshul du bskyed: dbang bskur byin rlabs la sogs mchod bstod bya: 'bod rbad gsad pa'i dmigs pa rtse gcig pas: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa:

'khor gyi sngags bzlas rang rig ngang du bsgom: dregs pa rang rgyud mi lta man ngag gces: mchod bstod dngos grub gsol la dkyil 'khor bsdu: man ngag bla ma'i zhal dang rgyud lung bsdeb: mthu nus thogs med dgra bgegs brlag pa'i mchog: bstan pa srung ba'i btsas su sa ma ya: i thi rgya: ༈ ྈ dug lnga gnas dag ye shes lnga dbang rdzogs: sgo gsum gdod nas rnam dag sku gsung thugs: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros spyan drangs bsam: sha chen gu gul bsregs shing rkang gling 'bud: hūm̐: rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: gdug pa 'dul phyir gsang bdag 'phrul pa'i sku: stobs ldan nag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: hūm̐: dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas dam pa 'dir: dregs pa ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: khro rgyal yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las skur bzhengs pa'i: he ru ka pa'i tshogs rnams la: gus pa'i yid kyis gar dang bcas: brkyang bskum stabs kyis phyag bgyi 'o: a ti bhū ho: pra ti bhu ho: hūm̐: ru dra bsgral pa las byung ba'i: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra: he ru ka yi tshogs la 'bul: ma hā puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pū dza ho: hūm̐: gti mug bsgral ba'i sha chen dang: 'dod chags 'bar ba'i khrag chen dang: zhe sdang 'bar ba'i rus chen rnams: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: rang byung gdod nas dag pa'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas: he ru ka yi tshogs la 'bul: sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: mtshan don sbyar zhing dngos grub blang:

༈ dmod pa drag sngags kyi bdud rtsi lag mchod ni/ bcom ldan kun bzang he ru ka'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhal du= dpal chen stobs ldan nag po'i zhal du= las can drwa ma lnga'i zhal du= skal ldan rdo rje chos kyi zhal du= slob dpon shān+tiṃ gar+bha'i zhal du= pa gor bai ro tsa na'i zhal du= lha sras dam 'dzin chen po'i zhal du= gter chen mchog gyur gling pa'i zhal du= rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du= yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du= ye shes 'jig rten chos skyong zhal du= gter srung dregs pa pho mo'i zhal du= snang srid dag pa rab 'byams zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'ang karma ka theg mchog ming 'dzin gyis bris pa'o// lce yi rdo rje'i dam tshig la: rnal 'byor can gyis hūm̐ bsgom zhing: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dngos grub blangs: lce la thim pas mchog thob 'gyur: sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: dung chen snod du ru dra bsgral: dmar chen rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo: 'khor ba stongs pa'i rak+ta 'di: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod nang du: srid gsum bsgral pa'i ba liṃ ta: dpal gyi gtor ma chen po 'di: he ru ka yi tshogs la 'bul: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: chos dbyings yum gyi bha ga'i klong: bde chen thabs kyi rdo rjes srub: bde stong 'du 'bral med pa 'di: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā mu drā bhañja mok+ṣa pū dza ho: hūm̐: nga la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: lha 'am 'on te bdud kyang rung: e yi dkyil 'khor chen por bsgral: dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal du bstab: ma hā ru dra khā hi: ༈ ྈ hūm̐: stobs ldan nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa: rdo rje dung khrag lha klu'i tsit+ta bsnams: zhabs bzhi rab bgrad spu gri'i gshog pa lding: 'jigs rung gar dgu dur khrod chas brgyad brjid: 'byung lnga'i bdag mo mthing nag khro mo'i chas:
